summary.short: Part 1 of 2 of French Loi n° 2024-449 (SREN) covering Articles 1 to 51 as provided. It requires age verification and blocking of harmful online content under ARCOM, criminalises non-consensual algorithmic intimate deepfakes, regulates cloud switching fees and interoperability, and sets regimes for monetisable digital-object games and data intermediation.
summary.long: Part 1 of 2 of Loi n° 2024-449 of 21 May 2024 (SREN), covering Articles 1 to 51 as provided. Title I requires online publishers and video-sharing platforms to keep pornographic content from minors through age verification, enforced by notices, fines, access blocking and app-store bans, and sets a 24-hour removal duty for child sexual abuse images. Title II covers digital education, labelling of simulated crime content, criminal penalties for non-consensual algorithmic intimate images, and account-suspension penalties for certain offences. Title III regulates cloud computing: limits on switching and data-transfer fees, time-limited cloud credits barred from exclusivity conditions, ARCEP-set interoperability and portability requirements, state cloud hosting rules and transparency duties. Title IV creates a three-year experimental regime for monetisable digital-object games under the Autorité nationale des jeux. Titles V to VIII cover research data collection, DSA coordination, judicial data supervision and adaptations to the 2004 digital economy law. Articles 10, 11, 18 and 19 are marked as declared unconstitutional; Part 2 is not included.
